options.systemMessage:
You are the client support assistant for Your Firm Name, an accounting and tax firm in India.
You talk to clients over web chat, WhatsApp and phone (voice). Answer questions about GST and income tax due dates, required documents, invoice status, and our services in simple, friendly language.
Reply in the same language the client uses (Hindi, English or Hinglish).
For voice calls keep every answer to one or two short sentences, with no lists or symbols.
Use the CRM: Check Invoice Status tool when a client gives an invoice number.
Knowledge base: GSTR-1 is due on the 11th and GSTR-3B on the 20th of every month. Monthly bookkeeping packages start at Rs. 5,000.
Never give legal or investment advice. If you are unsure, say a team member will follow up within one working day.

parameters.toolDescription: Look up the payment status of an invoice. Use when the client mentions an invoice number like INV-2026-001.

parameters.content:
## 1. Invoice Automation
Webhook receives an invoice request, GST and total are calculated, record is pushed to the accounting tool. Invoices above Rs. 50,000 go for partner approval; others are emailed and also sent on WhatsApp.

To activate: add Gmail credential, WhatsApp token and phone number ID in the HTTP node, and replace placeholder emails, phones and links.

## 2. Payment Recovery Automation
Every morning, overdue invoices are routed by days overdue. Each client-facing stage sends Email, then WhatsApp, then an AI voice call (Sarvam voice agent via HTTP). 30+ days goes to the partner.

To activate: replace mock Code node with real data; fill Sarvam org ID, workspace ID, API key, agent app ID, connection ID and agent phone number in the Voice Call nodes.

## 3. GST / Tax Compliance Automation
On the 1st of each month, each client return is checked. Data received: net GST payable is computed and the summary goes by Email and WhatsApp. Data missing: client gets Email, WhatsApp and an AI voice call asking for registers.

To activate: replace mock data and fill the Sarvam and WhatsApp placeholders.

## 4. Document Collection Automation
Every Monday, clients with pending documents get Email, WhatsApp and an AI voice call. After 3 reminders the team is alerted to call the client.

To activate: connect your tracker, set your real upload link and fill the Sarvam and WhatsApp placeholders.

## 5. AI Client Support (Web chat + WhatsApp + Voice)
One AI agent answers three channels. Web chat streams directly. WhatsApp messages arrive on the incoming webhook and the reply goes back via the WhatsApp HTTP node. For voice, the Sarvam voice agent calls the voice webhook as a tool with the caller's question, and n8n returns the answer for the agent to speak.

To activate: add OpenAI credential on the Chat Model node, point the Meta WhatsApp webhook to the incoming URL, set the Sarvam agent tool URL to the voice webhook, and replace the mock knowledge base.
